title: The Man Who Accidentally Killed The Most People In History
beats: One scientist, three inventions, millions dead, lower IQ, crime, two environmental disasters
Patterson on Manhattan Project, mass spectrometers
Radioactive rocks are clocks; U-238 to lead-206 chain
Zircon calibration: no lead initially; Patterson's lead far too high
Where did extra lead come from?
1908 Byron Carter death leads Leland and Kettering to self-starter
How knocking works; heptane vs iso-octane; octane scale defined arbitrarily
Live piston demo: 98 octane vs diesel
Midgley tries butter, camphor, ethanol, tellurium; each fails on a criterion
Tetraethyl lead: cheap, odorless, 1 part in 1000; naming it Ethyl hides lead
Marketing, Indy 500, plant poisonings, Midgley's press stunt
Why lead is toxic: mimics calcium, brain damage
Franklin and public health officials warn; dismissed
Leaded air contaminates Patterson's samples; he builds cleanroom
Meteorites as age source; 4.55 billion years
How natural is the lead? Ocean depth profile expects flat, finds 10x at surface
Ice cores give timeline; bones 1000x vs expected 100x
Baby teeth, IQ, 800 million IQ points
Crime curve offset 20 years; spurious correlation raised then argued against
Death toll estimate 25 million US, ~100 million globally
Freon and CFCs, ozone, Midgley's death by own invention
Bans, UN savings, leaded avgas still used

new_moves.what: Two parallel lives whose inventions and measurements collide

theory: The video teaches by planting a puzzle (Patterson's inexplicable lead) and delaying the answer through a parallel story whose payoff retroactively explains it. The transferable move is to state, before each dataset, what the result would look like under each hypothesis, so the data lands as a test.
velocity: Orchestrator: support a planted-mystery arc with a callback beat scheduled many minutes later
Scene builder: expected-versus-observed chart where learner predicts the ocean lead profile before reveal
Learner model: track open mysteries to ensure each is closed
Voice: narrative stories carry emotional weight; use for dependency-light context beats
Evals: check hypotheses stated before data
quote: a useful truth may be known long before it is practiced
